text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both showing mild positive momentum near resistance levels, with BTC holding ground above $83k and ETH near $2.7k, though neither has broken out decisively. The Fear & Greed index sits firmly in greed territory at 71 with no directional shift over a week, suggesting confidence is stable but not accelerating. Bitcoin's elevated dominance at 58.3% paired with moderate total volume of $108B indicates money is rotating toward the largest assets rather than flowing broadly into altcoins.
